ios.desc:
Still checking for sales? Hear every sale. TapRev rings your iPhone for each one from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad and six more, and keeps one number for your business: MRR, or revenue if you sell once.

Connect Stripe, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Gumroad, FastSpring, Dodo Payments, Creem, RevenueCat, Superwall or Square with your own API key, read-only wherever the platform offers one. One is enough; connect more and they join the same number. No account. Your keys and your numbers stay on your phone.

FREE TO START
Free, for good: a notification for every sale, your number each morning, the Journey and its widget. Your first week has all of Pro. After it, Pro keeps the dashboard, every sale and the figure widgets, and adds Instant Alerts within seconds. Monthly, yearly, or Lifetime at its launch price for the first 200 buyers.

YOUR METRICS, ONE SCREEN
- Your number, MRR or revenue, with its trend and a goal you set
- Revenue by day, week or month, recurring and one-time
- Active, cancelling, past-due and trialing subscriptions
- Churn rate on the period's cohort
- Active customers over time, and who paid the most
- Revenue by platform, and a page per platform
- Any currency; amounts shown in the one you choose

IT RINGS THE MOMENT YOU'RE PAID
Every sale, renewal, refund and chargeback as a notification, with the amount. Milestones from $100 to $1M MRR, a daily summary at the hour you choose, and a weekly one on Mondays. With Pro's Instant Alerts, your platforms wake the phone within seconds of a sale.

HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Small, medium and large widgets with MRR, ARR, today's revenue and thirty days of sales, plus Lock Screen widgets.

THE JOURNEY
Over a hundred badges in eighteen tracks, earned from real revenue: your first sale and your hundred-thousandth, the $100 to $1M summits, the first $1,000 earned to the ten-millionth, days sold in a row, renewals, customers in fifty countries, a comeback, ten years in. Every locked badge shows how far you are. A Journey tab to see them, a Home Screen widget for the day and its affirmation, a card to share each one whenever you like, and every sale alert says how far the next summit is. An affirmation a day, a year of original ones, in a morning notification you can turn off; every one and every moment a card worth posting.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
- No account, no server holding your data
- API keys live in the iOS Keychain and are sent only to the platform they belong to
- Ev
